symptom: Every `bash` call — in the parent agent and in every subagent — returned "Run the command with ctx_execute... context-mode: the hook failed (NODE_TOO_OLD)". `grep`/`find`/`ls` were denied the same way. Patching the gate in node_modules did not help within the session, so 6 subagents were blocked from running any command.
cause: The context-mode pi extension fails CLOSED: `pi/index.js` `handleHook()` does `if (nodeTooOld(process.version)) return fail7("node", new CtxError("NODE_TOO_OLD"))`, which turns every intercepted tool into a deny. Node on PATH was v22.20 but context-mode needs >=24.15. Patching the file has no effect on the running session because the extension is already loaded in pi's process memory — it needs a pi restart.
fix: Two paths. (1) Real fix: install Node >=24.15 (nvm had v24.21.0 available) and restart pi; or patch `~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/context-mode/pi/index.js` line ~19944 to fail OPEN — replace `return fail7("node", new CtxError("NODE_TOO_OLD", ...))` with `return row5.encode({event:"PreToolUse", ...}, {kind:"allow"})` — then restart pi. (2) Workaround that needs no restart: the `hypa_shell` / `hypa_read` / `hypa_grep` tool family is NOT intercepted by the context-mode hook, so it keeps working. Use hypa_shell for all shell work, and drive Blender through the blender MCP `execute_blender_code` tool (exec(open(path).read())) instead of shelling out. Subagents have no such escape hatch — give them `read`/`write`/`edit`-only tasks, or have them author probe scripts that the parent runs.
verify: `hypa_shell` with `echo hi` succeeds while `bash` with `echo hi` returns the NODE_TOO_OLD deny. After a pi restart on Node 24, `bash` works and `ctx_doctor` reports D2 node PASS.
